# Version 4.152.0
> **Graphite and Skia m152** · Released September 5, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.152.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.200/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 adds Graphite GPU bindings and async pixel reads alongside the Skia m152 engine update. It also strengthens native-object lifetime handling, improves common data paths, adds the Vulkan Silk.NET package, and expands Nano Server font support.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated through milestone m152** — The bundled renderer advances through the m151 and m152 upstream servicing syncs, including the Chrome m152 use-after-free correction. ([#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568), [#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4808](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4808), [#4925](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4925))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend bindings** — New bindings expose Skia's Graphite backend for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn integrations. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Backend-neutral asynchronous pixel reads** — SKImage and SKSurface gain RequestReadPixels APIs for asynchronous pixel readback across graphics backends. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native-backed objects retain their pixel and region sources** — SKRegion iterators and SKPixmap subsets now keep their backing objects alive, preventing native use-after-free failures. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558))
- **Raster creation cleans up failed allocations** — SKImage raster creation now releases its CoTaskMem pixel buffer when native construction fails. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Faster managed data and uniform paths** — SKData.SaveTo, encoded-text access, runtime-effect uniform lookup, handle registration, and tag formatting avoid unnecessary copies, allocations, or reflection. ([#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512), [#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550), [#4630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4630), [#4752](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4752))
- **Runtime-effect uniform reset releases prior buffers** — Resetting SKRuntimeEffectUniforms disposes the previous uniform buffer instead of retaining native resources. ([#4783](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4783))

## Platform

- **Vulkan Silk.NET package restored** — SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET is produced again, providing a maintained package path for Silk.NET Vulkan applications. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527), [#4841](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4841))
- **Nano Server font support uses FreeType** — Nano Server native assets use FreeType so applications have bundled font support on that target. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.200

HarfBuzzSharp improves Font.Shape by avoiding a defensive feature-array copy and shares the release's updated package documentation and native packaging work.
